reasoning_steps: Correctly find the radius as 12/2 = 6 cm.
Use the sector-area formula (60/360) × π × 6^2 instead of the arc-length formula.
Obtain 6π and report an area as though it were the requested length.

Calculate the arc length as 12π/12 = π.
